title: Hearty Indulgent Filipino Mackerel Adobo
description: A fresh and snappy Filipino dish featuring mackerel in a rich adobo sauce, made with lardons-render and vegan-friendly ingredients. This indulgent recipe is perfect for a special occasion.
instructions: Heat the lardons in a large saucepan over medium heat until crispy.
Remove the crispy lardons from the saucepan and set aside.
Add the minced garlic and chopped onion to the saucepan and saute until fragrant.
Add the mackerel fillets to the saucepan and cook for 2 minutes on each side.
Add the soy sauce, vinegar, bay leaves, and black pepper to the saucepan and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Return the crispy lardons to the saucepan and stir to combine.
Serve the mackerel adobo hot, garnished with chopped green onions and steamed rice on the side.
